## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-3003. The ingest-worker pods were restarting due to out-of-memory kills caused by the data-platform namespace's default 512 MiB memory limit being insufficient for the morning batch load. The pods' memory usage reached 497 MiB during batch processing, exceeding the limit and triggering kernel OOM termination. The fix is to increase both the memory request and limit in the deployment manifest to at least 1Gi (limit) and 512Mi-768Mi (request), then redeploy.
